status: engineering_proposal_and_static_evidence; no SSH or new EDA
architecture: 20 physical nonbinary redundant weights -> calibrated16bit reconstruction; no raw truncation

pin_numbering: Logical budget numbering only; not approved package/bondwire placement. Exposed pad if chosen is an additional terminal and must be defined separately.

recommended_source_synchronous_burst.mode: SDR, two data lanes, source DCO

other_options: A 20bit minimal frame still needs100Mbps aggregate; two50Mbps lanes leave no idle margin.
A 32bit frame with CRC8 needs160Mbps aggregate; two100Mbps SDR lanes use16 cycles/160ns and40ns idle, before physical/timing margins.
One lane needs at least120Mbps for the24bit frame; faster signaling needs a proven SMIC18 I/O/board contract.
serial_link.spi_cfg: Separate low-rate configuration/debug bus, initial <=10MHz proposal; cannot transport full-rate5MS/s16bit ADC output.
serial_link.timing_status: 100MHz SDR is a scheduling target only. Real SMIC18 pad/ESD voltage, speed, skew, receiver setup/hold, load and board SI are unverified; no serializer exists in current core.
serial_link.pairing_status: Internal raw/residue association must use retained samples and tags; short outgoing sequence count is only a diagnostic and does not prove CDC/association.
serial_link.launch_capture_phase: Prefer data launch and source DCO capture separated in phase (e.g. opposite edges, nominal5ns at100MHz) with clean clock gating. This is a proposed IO timing contract; actual pad/board skew and setup/hold must be signed off.

reconstruction_resources.source: local downloaded sar_reconstruction.sv; static reading only; not new synthesis
reconstruction_resources.temporary_variables: Three named 40bit blocking temporaries are same-cycle scaling expressions; no additional persistent 120bit bank is required by the algorithm. Optimization/elaboration still needs synthesis.

combinational_resource_model.extra_unmapped: 20 signed +/- selections, 4 initial negations, weight write enables/muxes/clock gates, constant rounder, saturation, SRM subtraction and protocol logic; fixed sign extension can reduce upper carry logic.

limitations: 819 is an architectural bit count, not a mapped-cell count; the unreset initial RAM requires valid hardware initialization.
Current core shadow 600 FF has no reconstruction read port; reuse requires architectural change and verification.
Legacy reconstruction omits SRM subtraction and calibrated total-weight gain normalization; its initial low six weights are zero until seeded.
The area range does not establish 100MHz timing across a five-term combinational accumulation chain.
A fully programmable final gain multiplier or deep FIFO is not covered as an implemented function; coefficient/macro choice may move the budget.

spi_protocol_parallel_output_new_cell.scope: CFG/status/test, raw/residue pairing and separate output double buffers, serializer/control glue;132FF buffer model is included, no extra addition. No realpad area.

default_parallel_digital_macro.formula: (existing_cell + new_cell) / 0.55 * 1.07; no pad ring, analog area or whole-chip floorplan margin

serializer_two_lane_incremental_cell.scope: Sub-budget inside the combined interface allocation for selected serial方案; do not add again to selected_folded_serial_total_new_cell.

default_serial_digital_macro.formula: (existing_cell + new_cell) / 0.55 * 1.07; no pad ring, analog area or whole-chip floorplan margin

folded_reconstruction_alternative_new_ce.target_schedule: two weights per 100MHz cycle: 10 accumulation cycles plus approximately 3 merge/residue/round cycles; not measured
folded_reconstruction_alternative_new_ce.constraints: 600bit new weight memory retained; no automatic shadow reuse. Two banked reads/cycle, 35bit safe accumulators, raw/residue double buffering, tags and errors need functional/formal/synth/STA; final gain/scale rules pending.

exclusions: Real SMIC18 pad and ESD ring, level shifters/high-voltage devices and their keepouts
Analog custom macros, digital/analog isolation and chip seal ring
Unbudgeted large variable-gain multiplier, deep sample FIFO, redundant shadow refresh or timing-driven extra pipeline
Any claim that old non-SMIC analog layout can be directly merged into the SMIC18 digital layout

selected_folded_serial_total_new_cell.scope: folded reconstruction .065-.100 plus SPI/protocol/132FF buffers/serializer .010-.020; serializer/buffers included, not double counted

area_budget.conservative_unrolled_baseline_note: New cell nominal .135 -> macro .461656569mm2; interface allocation includes selected serial output. Old expanded arithmetic is a conservative reuse/reference scenario, not the selected folded plan.

selected_folded_serial_interface_new_cel.scope: SPI/protocol/132FF pairing-frame buffers/serializer combined; buffers also serve serializer, do not add serializer sub-budget again

required_new_functions: Onchip weighted reconstruction including low-six initialization, SRM sign/scale, residue subtraction and final normalization/rounding/saturation
SPI CFG/status/weight debug and TEST_MODE route; SPI does not exist in current core
Raw/sample retention, SRM ready/prearm, timeout/stale-done recovery, reset-release synchronization and sample association
CNV/analog phase ownership and safe DAC-force mux; abstract force code is not a gate switch signal
Parallel source-synchronous output register/valid or24bit two-lane serializer, frame start, limited elastic buffer and output timing
SMIC18-specific pads, ESD, voltage-domain interfaces and package/power verification
Internal bias generation or validated VCM sharing can later save pins; neither is assumed in the48/32pin prototype.
Repair original SRM arm/abort/stale-done ownership inside the RTL; external pin protocol alone is insufficient.
bias_status: VB/VBC remain two external adjustable voltage pins in the first prototype; no internal bias generator implementation is assumed.

selection.user_preference: Fewer package pins; serial sample output plus separate SPI configuration
selection.area_primary: folded two-weight/cycle candidate; not implemented or verified

folded_pipeline_schedule.status: illustrative_budget; not executed or formal proof
stages: t0..t100ns: two banked weights/clk, 10cycles for20 terms
t110..t120ns: residue sign/scale conversion and subtract (exact format pending)
t120..t130ns: defined normalization/round/saturation and enqueue24bit frame
folded_pipeline_schedule.overlap: Frame k can serialize while sample k+1 reconstructs using separate registers/clock enables. Need raw/residue double-buffered slots and an output frame latch/limited queue.
folded_pipeline_schedule.latency: Example is measured from coherent raw/residue pair ready, not from analog CNV. Pipeline250ns initial delivery latency is compatible with200ns sample spacing if all stages keep the rate.
folded_pipeline_schedule.faults: Current SRM late old-done misattribution requires an internal arm/abort/epoch repair and verification. A package handshake cannot mask the RTL bug. On timeout/missing pair/queue overflow emit explicit invalid/error frame and release/flush ownership; two entries do not guarantee recovery under unbounded stalls.
folded_pipeline_schedule.gain_note: A programmable normalization multiply cannot be assumed to fit one cycle or this area. Either prove a pre-normalized weight/residue coordinate established during calibration, or add a separately pipelined gain unit and its budget.

interface_buffer_resources.accounting: Already inside .010-.020mm2 combined protocol/SPI/output budget; do not add again. Output buffer can supply serializer state, rather than unconditionally adding another24bit bank.
interface_buffer_resources.limits: No SPI configuration/state registers or gates included in132-bit floor; actual buffers also need valid/ownership and implemented reset/write behavior. Total budget remains an assumption.
